stem: An alcoholic develops confusion, ophthalmoplegia and ataxia (Wernicke encephalopathy). Deficiency of which vitamin, a coenzyme for pyruvate dehydrogenase and transketolase, is responsible?
concept: Thiamine (B1), as thiamine pyrophosphate, is a coenzyme for pyruvate dehydrogenase, alpha-ketoglutarate dehydrogenase and transketolase. Deficiency causes beriberi and Wernicke-Korsakoff syndrome, common in alcoholics.
subject: Biochemistry
